# Ship
## When to use
Requested delivery only.
## Required context
Diff and review results.
## Preconditions
Irreversible actions need human approval unless already explicitly authorized.
## Procedure
Check proof and scope before commit, push, PR or deployment.
Activate `change-delivery` for detailed delivery safeguards.
## Tools
Authorized delivery tools.
## Rules
Respect explicit no-delivery requests.
## Verification
Confirm actual delivery state.
## Evidence
Results, identifiers and limits.
## Completion criteria
Only authorized actions occurred.
## Failure modes
Missing proof: report the blocker.
## References
[Delivery boundaries](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. Always run it from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
